digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Today stayed focused on delegated coverage while you were out, and Monday’s calendar is set. Eight follow-ups remain open, led by the Amazon Connect, Attorney Review, and self-review items that need early confirmation.

items.label: Confirm all five team self-reviews with HR
items.detail: Jean told HR that the team had completed the self-reviews and asked for confirmation, but a later HR message still listed Laura and Mar. Confirm all five submissions are recorded as complete.

items.label: Set Amazon Connect coverage and the revised Denver path
items.detail: Salesforce still had no resolution by late afternoon, although Ashley escalated with the Salesforce account executive. Confirm Monday’s coverage, close the user and queue checks, and set the go/no-go posture for the proposed Tuesday, September 29 Denver deployment.

items.label: Choose the Attorney Review launch and coverage plan
items.detail: More than 23 appointments are booked for the October 17 Salt Lake City opening, and the email thread still did not show a full attorney-coverage solution. Confirm coverage and whether the rollout remains October 17 or moves to October 19.

items.label: Record and communicate the RFE MHE hold
items.detail: The project remains paused while Legal guidance and historical data are reviewed. Document the review owners, the trigger for resuming planning, and the effect on scope and timing.

items.label: Set the CM-CoE backlog and Sprint 19 path
items.detail: Confirm owners and Sprint placement for the Phase 1 and Phase 2 requests, and set a follow-up date for the Timetrack feedback so the queue does not remain open-ended.

items.label: Connect with Amy on Incident Response communications
items.detail: Confirm the Bucket 6 notification trigger, communication owner, and remaining Incident Response Guide inputs with Amy, who is leading internal communications and PR.

items.label: Share the new legal-guidance protocol with the remaining PMs
items.detail: Explain when to include Leo, Raquel, or Cristian and ask teams to distinguish mandatory legal requirements from recommendations.

items.label: Clarify the held Quality-routing deadline
items.detail: Send the interim status, revised decision point, and communication owner while the work waits for the new Phase 1 matter-plan structure.

items.label: The 10:30 AM Salesforce Program Standup was canceled
items.detail: The separate Amazon Connect daily standup remained active.

items.label: The 2:30 PM project pipeline weekly sync was canceled
items.detail: The cancellation was confirmed in Teams and on the calendar.

items.label: 8:00 AM - Approve timecards and prepare the week
items.detail: Clear approvals and turn Friday’s delegated readouts into Monday priorities.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect daily standup
items.detail: Bring the Salesforce escalation status, completed testing prerequisites, and a firm go/no-go posture for Tuesday’s proposed Denver deployment.

items.label: Noon-1:30 PM - Protected work block
items.detail: Reserve the time for Amazon Connect and Attorney Review follow-through before the afternoon meetings.

items.label: 2:00-4:00 PM - BD review and back-to-back 1:1s
items.detail: The BD Portfolio Review is followed by 1:1s with Maria and Rahul. Use the sequence to settle the new-client scoping path, portfolio ownership, and next-week commitments.
